prompt: gentle acoustic folk, warm vocals, fingerpicked guitar
lyrics:
[Verse]
The tide pulls back to make room for the sand,
A lesson I learned when I was just a hand
Held tight by the moonlight and salt air's sweet breath,
Watching the old stories of my father fade death.

[Chorus]
Oh, growing up means letting go of what you know,
Like the gulls flying far above the low shore blow,
We learn to dance where the waves gently creep,
And find our peace in a quiet deep dream.
source_text: a warm song about growing up by the sea
